name: ci-red-unchanged
about: CI fails on the PR's head and land sends the item back to build (a counted bounce), with the failing job's log attached as ci-failure.log, which the next build's brief points at. The build finds nothing to fix and reports the same head: loopd sends the item to the user (needs-you, return stage land) instead of another review, and nothing merges.

question.a: ^CI failed on [0-9a-f]{7} and the build changed nothing: rerun CI, fix main, or drop$

messages.text: ^Back to build: CI failed on `[0-9a-f]{7}`: check
needs you: CI failed on [0-9a-f]{7} and the build changed nothing: rerun CI, fix main, or drop

run_files.text: - \*\*CI failed; the runner fetched its log\*\*: `\.loop/triage/[0-9]+-ci-failure\.log` \(CI failure on [0-9a-f]{7}: check\): .*usually a race
